methods.design: Each workload pair ran on the same physical board and boot. Three boards started the main pass with the v0.9.4 SDK and three with the RC. Entries marked follow-up are paired on a subsequent boot, RC first. Earlier observations are retained when available. Every arm started with an empty device. Catalog apps and standalone workloads were installed by manifest digest.
methods.runtime_bench: Three batches of ten iterations per allocator per board. The program validates its outputs and reports the median batch duration. Divide by ten for ms per iteration.
methods.controls: Identical signed probes, seven measured batches after two warmups. Divide milliseconds by 32 for the neural model, otherwise 256.
methods.coremark: Iterations per second. Three independent installs for each fitting size. Stop for that size on contiguous allocation failure.
methods.mqtt: 48 successful QoS 1 round trips over TLS per board per arm. qos1_us are microseconds.
methods.memory: Console free RAM before app load in empty, and while running in pair and blink. Runtime status counters are cached firmware readings in bytes and may predate an app transition. The C5 TinyGo follow-up uses the startup log instead, which samples heap immediately after instantiation and rounds down to whole KiB.
methods.fragmentation: Classic ESP32. One fresh install per allocator. 24,576 mixed operations, 12 whole-arena checks, five fixed free-list depths and 256 single-call samples per depth. Elapsed milliseconds include scheduling.
